::: {.letter-metadata}
**Date:** July 14th 1879  
**From:** Elderfield, Otterbourne, Winchester.  
**Manuscript:** MS British Library Add MSS 54921: 104
:::

Dear [Mr Craik](people/person_379.qmd)

I will soon send material for the other pages. I have a queer little drama half written, and one or two other things that only require to be got into shape[^1]

Yours truly
C M Yonge

---

[^1]: This was extra material to make up the collection of previously published stories which appeared as *Bye-Words* (1879). The 'queer little drama' was 'The Campbells are Coming'.
